text: {"title":"Error rate by route","timeRange":{"from":"now-1h","to":"now"},"refreshIntervalMs":15000,"panels":[{"id":"error-rate-by-route","title":"Error rate by route","description":"Per-second rate of error-level api log lines, grouped by the route field parsed from each JSON log line, in errors per second.","viz":"line","format":"number","query":{"sourceId":"eval-loki-demo","logql":"sum by (route) (rate({app=\"api\", level=\"error\"} | json [5m]))"},"options":{"unit":"req/s","legend":"bottom"},"layout":{"x":0,"y":0,"w":6,"h":4}},{"id":"error-ratio-by-route","title":"Error ratio by route","description":"Ratio of error-level api log lines to all api log lines over the last hour, grouped by the route field parsed from each JSON log line, as a fraction.","viz":"bar","format":"percent","query":{"sourceId":"eval-loki-demo","logql":"sum by (route) (count_over_time({app=\"api\", level=\"error\"} | json [1h])) / sum by (route) (count_over_time({app=\"api\"} | json [1h]))","instant":true},"options":{"decimals":2,"legend":"none"},"layout":{"x":6,"y":0,"w":6,"h":4}}]}
